targetText:
The employés
themselves fixed the price and plundered at will the unhappy Hindus.
explanation: Key theoretical concept in Genesis of the Industrial Capitalist: Marxists analyze how structural economic conditions determine political and social relations under capitalism.

targetText:
The nations bragged cynically of every infamy that served
them as a means to capitalistic accumulation.
explanation: Modern relevance: understanding these underlying systemic dynamics helps clarify contemporary economic policies and labor movements.
